hook_pattern.description: Opens directly on a provocative existential or personal-crisis question, named in the source analysis as a '30 Saniye Kuralı' (30-second rule) though observed hooks range roughly 30-45s (e.g. 'Dünyaya gelmek bir lütuf mu, yoksa telafisi imkansız bir zarar mı?') - no channel-intro ritual, no 'hoş geldiniz'. Titles/thumbnails borrow Format-A mystery framing ('Tarihin En Tehlikeli Filozofu', 'İnsan Irkına Karşı Bir Komplo Teorisi') even when the video's actual content stays Format-B philosophical depth - the mystery hook is a packaging device, not a content strategy.

disclaimer: Structural/format analysis only. No content reproduction.
title_pattern: Existential/personal-crisis question or imperative aimed at the viewer's own life ('Neden Hep Yorgunsun?', 'Hayatını Nasıl Erteliyorsun?', 'Neden Yalnızsın?') OR historical-mystery framing used as a title/thumbnail hook only ('Tarihin En Tehlikeli Filozofu', 'İnsan Irkına Karşı Bir Komplo Teorisi', 'Ateizmin Unutulmuş Kitabı') while the video body stays philosophical-curation in substance.
notes: UPDATE (supersedes this profile's first version): the user supplied a detailed 50-point applied analysis (10 PDFs, testing the same K1-K23/persona/hybrid-model rule set from CFP-0002/CFP-0003 directly against 8 named Sercan Baylan videos with concrete examples) - archived in reports/source_docs/sercanbaylan_*.pdf. This is meaningfully stronger evidence than this profile's original WebSearch-only pass, so confidence rose from 0.3 to 0.75 and several fields that were previously left unset are now filled from the user's applied analysis rather than my own secondhand web research. One earlier claim in this profile was WRONG and is corrected here: the channel is NOT narration-over-paired-visuals - it is a talking-head format, presenter seated at a desk, direct eye contact with camera, warm yellow/brown consistent color grade, bright 'intellectual library' lighting (Nida Yıldırım's 'Boutique Intellectual' aesthetic, not Gerçeği Bul's dark/mysterious one). Structurally: videos run 10-20 min, most often ~12-15 min, with a mid-video twist/second question around minute 7-8 to re-hook attention; pacing deliberately avoids jump cuts, leaves natural 1-2s pauses between sentences, and never chases fast/dopamine-style editing; music is neoclassical/orchestral (Scott Buckley-adjacent: cello, violin, piano), sits at background 'fon' level most of the time and only becomes noticeable at reveals/theses, synced to the narrator's pauses rather than continuous - hence music_density 'moderate' rather than 'dense'/'continuous'. Content is evidence-based (named philosophers/books cited throughout: Schopenhauer, Ligotti, Benatar, Aristotle, Nietzsche) and consistently ends on a 'safe exit' - a settled, non-despairing philosophical close - after heavy existential subject matter. Overall: this channel is Format-B (Nida Yıldırım / philosophical depth) dominant, using Format-A (Gerçeği Bul / mystery) only at the title-and-hook layer, never in the body content or in doubt-mongering toward institutions - this is a real precedent for exactly the 'hybrid without K4/K9' choice already made for TPL-baskurtlar-hybrid.json, not the reason that choice was made. Frame-exact metrics (cut_frequency_per_min, narration_pace_wpm, pacing_distribution percentages) still were not measured from actual footage/transcripts and remain unset rather than invented. Sources: reports/source_docs/sercanbaylan_video_sistemi_analiz_kriterleri_50madde.pdf, sercanbaylan_analiz_bolum01-10.pdf (user-supplied); prior WebSearch sources retained from this profile's first version (sercanbaylan.com).
